name: Limit
definition: Value used for risk containment in a system or towards counterparts. The limit may be a current limit or a default limit.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money of the limit, expressed in a currency.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies if a limit is a debit limit or a credit limit.

UsedAmount.name: Used Amount
UsedAmount.definition: Actual usage of the limit expressed as an amount.

UsedPercentage.name: Used Percentage
UsedPercentage.definition: Actual usage of the limit expressed as a percentage.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency unit used to specify the limit amount.

Percentage.name: Percentage
Percentage.definition: Specifies that the limit is a percentage of a related amount.

Periodicity.name: Periodicity
Periodicity.definition: Specifies the periodicity linked to a limit for example the periodicity can indicate that the limit can be reached daily or monthly.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Specifies that the limit is a quantity.

AvailableAmount.name: Available Amount
AvailableAmount.definition: Remaining amount of money of the limit.

RelatedDebitCreditFacility.name: Related Debit Credit Facility
RelatedDebitCreditFacility.definition: Overdraft conditions for which limit parameters are specified.

ValidityPeriod.name: Validity Period
ValidityPeriod.definition: Period at which the limit is effective.

RelatedPaymentCard.name: Related Payment Card
RelatedPaymentCard.definition: Payment card for which a limit is specified.
